subject: Isolated hosting audit schedule, access constraints and committed-discount request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Private - audit schedule + data residency + discount ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme's IT and procurement teams reviewed the whitepaper and have three items that need confirmation before we can move to legal:

- Audit window: We require a 2-3 week on-prem/remote audit window where our auditors get access to host/system logs and limited host inspection. Preferred slot: late July.
- Data residency & retention: All PHI must remain in us-east and retained for 24 months.
- Pricing: We are evaluating a 24-month committed reserved capacity; need a commercial concession — target 18-20% off list to align with our budget.

Attached is our standard questionnaire (Procurement). Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) support a July audit window with the access described, 2) guarantee the residency/retention, and 3) provide a path to the discount above?

We'd like to keep momentum and ideally get terms agreed to by the end of next week.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com

Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Private - audit schedule + data residency + discount ask

Samir —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick responses inline, and then proposed next steps: 

- Audit window: We can support a vendor audit in July but with constraints for Private/VPC: 
  * We offer a 10 business-day audit window (on-prem inspection + remote log review). Longer windows create operational risk for customers in multi-tenant or shared host environments.
  * Access model: read-only access to application and system logs exposed via a jumpbox and SFTP export; no direct host root access.
- Data residency & retention: We can commit to us-east residency for production data. Retention: standard is 12 months; for PHI we can extend to 18 months with a DPA addendum. 24 months is unusual on our hosted plan — we can discuss a tailored retention policy if you require it on Private (might require additional storage pricing).
- Pricing: For a 24-month reserved commitment we can extend a commercial concession. Initial internal guidance is a 12–15% committed discount; 18–20% would require exec-level signoff and deeper commitment (minimum seat/GPU quantity).

Next steps I propose:
1) I can share a drafted SOW with a proposed 10-business-day audit window and 18-month retention (attached).
2) If you need the 24-month retention + 20% discount, I'll escalate for executive approval; please confirm the committed capacity (monthly GPU equivalents) so I can put a precise finance ask forward.

If you can send a slot preference for July (week start dates), I'll hold tentative capacity.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v1.docx (SOW draft)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood Private - audit schedule + data residency + discount ask

Karthik —

I reviewed Samir's ask and your proposed concessions. For clarity and risk controls, legal and finance will approve the following commercial and controls concessions for Acme on a case-by-case basis:

- Discount: Approved up to 15% for a 24-month reserved commitment, contingent on minimum monthly GPU commitment = 8 GPU-eq and signed AR/AP terms. Any request >15% requires CRO/CFO signoff.
- Audit: Approve a time-boxed audit window up to 10 business days. Audit access must be strictly read-only; auditors must sign our vendor auditor NDA and follow the access matrix (no host root, no physical device custody).
- Data retention: Approve retention extension to 18 months for PHI; 24 months may be possible but requires an incremental storage surcharge and InfoSec review on backup/restore procedures.
- Security controls required: KMS-backed keys, restricted egress IP allow-list, and pre-approved audit playbook (we will provide).

If you confirm Acme's committed capacity and accept the 10-business-day audit + 18-month retention (with 15% discount), I'll prepare an exec-signed commercial memo and a DocuSign SOW.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Redwood Private - audit schedule + data residency + discount ask

Samir —

Thanks for the questionnaire — appreciated the detail. Quick summary / final proposal from Redwood:

1) Audit: We can run a vendor audit in the week of July 19th. Audit scope will be 10 business days, read-only access to logs via jumpbox/SFTP, and our audit playbook + auditor NDA must be in place beforehand. We cannot offer host-level root access or unlimited on-site device custody.
2) Data residency & retention: Production data will be hosted in us-east. We commit to 18 months retention for PHI under a DPA addendum. If you require 24 months, we will need to add a storage surcharge and run a short InfoSec review — let me know which you prefer.
3) Commercial: For a 24-month reserved commitment (8 GPU-eq / month minimum), Redwood can extend a 15% committed discount. Anything above 15% will need CRO/CFO approval.

Next steps:
- Please confirm: (A) preferred audit week (July 19 or July 26), (B) retention term (18 or 24 months), and (C) committed monthly GPU equivalents.
- I will circulate an exec-approved commercial memo and start the DocuSign SOW once you confirm. Link to the draft SOW: https://docusign.com/Acme-Redwood-SOW-ACME-2026-0412

If this works I'll have Rachel and Ben coordinate the audit playbook and logistics.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
